name: ivs
description: Introduction The Amazon Interactive Video Service (IVS) API is REST compatible, using a standard HTTP API and an Amazon Web Services EventBridge event stream for responses.

subcommands.name: batch-get-channel
subcommands.description: Performs GetChannel on multiple ARNs simultaneously.

subcommands.name: batch-get-stream-key
subcommands.description: Performs GetStreamKey on multiple ARNs simultaneously.

subcommands.name: batch-start-viewer-session-revocation
subcommands.description: Performs StartViewerSessionRevocation on multiple channel ARN and viewer ID pairs simultaneously.

subcommands.name: create-ad-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates a new ad configuration to be used for server-side ad insertion.

subcommands.name: create-channel
subcommands.description: Creates a new channel and an associated stream key to start streaming.

subcommands.name: create-playback-restriction-policy
subcommands.description: Creates a new playback restriction policy, for constraining playback by countries and/or origins.

subcommands.name: create-recording-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates a new recording configuration, used to enable recording to Amazon S3.

subcommands.name: create-stream-key
subcommands.description: Creates a stream key, used to initiate a stream, for the specified channel ARN.

subcommands.name: delete-ad-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified ad configuration.

subcommands.name: delete-channel
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified channel and its associated stream keys.

subcommands.name: delete-playback-key-pair
subcommands.description: Deletes a specified authorization key pair.

subcommands.name: delete-playback-restriction-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified playback restriction policy.

subcommands.name: delete-recording-configuration
subcommands.description: Deletes the recording configuration for the specified ARN.

subcommands.name: delete-stream-key
subcommands.description: Deletes the stream key for the specified ARN, so it can no longer be used to stream.

subcommands.name: get-ad-configuration
subcommands.description: Gets the ad configuration represented by the specified ARN.

subcommands.name: get-channel
subcommands.description: Gets the channel configuration for the specified channel ARN.

subcommands.name: get-playback-key-pair
subcommands.description: Gets a specified playback authorization key pair and returns the arn and fingerprint.

subcommands.name: get-playback-restriction-policy
subcommands.description: Gets the specified playback restriction policy.

subcommands.name: get-recording-configuration
subcommands.description: Gets the recording configuration for the specified ARN.

subcommands.name: get-stream
subcommands.description: Gets information about the active (live) stream on a specified channel.

subcommands.name: get-stream-key
subcommands.description: Gets stream-key information for a specified ARN.

subcommands.name: get-stream-session
subcommands.description: Gets metadata on a specified stream.

subcommands.name: import-playback-key-pair
subcommands.description: Imports the public portion of a new key pair and returns its arn and fingerprint.

subcommands.name: insert-ad-break
subcommands.description: Inserts an ad marker in the playlist for the specified channel and duration using the ad configuration associated with the channel.

subcommands.name: list-ad-configurations
subcommands.description: Gets summary information about all ad configurations in your account, in the AWS region where the API request is processed.

subcommands.name: list-channels
subcommands.description: Gets summary information about all channels in your account, in the Amazon Web Services region where the API request is processed.

subcommands.name: list-playback-key-pairs
subcommands.description: Gets summary information about playback key pairs.

subcommands.name: list-playback-restriction-policies
subcommands.description: Gets summary information about playback restriction policies.

subcommands.name: list-recording-configurations
subcommands.description: Gets summary information about all recording configurations in your account, in the Amazon Web Services region where the API request is processed.

subcommands.name: list-stream-keys
subcommands.description: Gets summary information about stream keys for the specified channel.

subcommands.name: list-stream-sessions
subcommands.description: Gets a summary of current and previous streams for a specified channel in your account, in the AWS region where the API request is processed.

subcommands.name: list-streams
subcommands.description: Gets summary information about live streams in your account, in the Amazon Web Services region where the API request is processed.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Gets information about Amazon Web Services tags for the specified ARN.

subcommands.name: put-metadata
subcommands.description: Inserts metadata into the active stream of the specified channel.

subcommands.name: start-viewer-session-revocation
subcommands.description: Starts the process of revoking the viewer session associated with a specified channel ARN and viewer ID.

subcommands.name: stop-stream
subcommands.description: Disconnects the incoming RTMPS stream for the specified channel.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds or updates tags for the Amazon Web Services resource with the specified ARN.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from the resource with the specified ARN.

subcommands.name: update-ad-configuration
subcommands.description: Updates a specified ad configuration.

subcommands.name: update-channel
subcommands.description: Updates a channel's configuration.

subcommands.name: update-playback-restriction-policy
subcommands.description: Updates a specified playback restriction policy.
